Class PhasedProxyServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.client.proxies.PhasedProxyServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Disconnectable, Heartbeatable, VirtualClient, VirtualGameClient, VirtualHallClient, VirtualRoomClient, VirtualGameServer, VirtualHallServer, VirtualRoomServer, VirtualServer, Serializable, Remote
Direct Known Subclasses:
RmiProxyServer, SocketProxyServer
public abstract class PhasedProxyServer extends Object implements VirtualClient, VirtualServer, Heartbeatable
The PhasedProxyServer abstract class acts as the client-side representative (Proxy) for the remote server. It bridges the local
invalid reference 
ClientApplication
with the network, abstracting away the underlying communication protocol (RMI or Socket). It continuously monitors the connection health via a heartbeat system and triggers emergency procedures if the server goes offline.

  • Method Details

    • runVirtualServer

      public void runVirtualServer() throws SocketException
      Starts the virtual server background processes, primarily initiating the heartbeat monitor. Implementing subclasses (like Socket) usually override this to also start the listening loop.
      Throws:
      SocketException - if an immediate connection loss is detected (for socket only), triggering a disconnection event chain.

    • finishInitialization

      public abstract void finishInitialization(VirtualServer serverSide, ObjectInputStream input, ObjectOutputStream output)
      Finalizes the initialization of the proxy with the specific network implementation details.
      Parameters:
      serverSide - the remote server RMI stub (null if using Sockets).
      input - the Socket input stream (null if using RMI).
      output - the Socket output stream (null if using RMI).

    • startHeartbeating

      public void startHeartbeating()
      Starts the asynchronous heartbeat system on the client side. It spins up two scheduled tasks: one to periodically ping the server, and another to monitor if the server has been silent for too long.
      Specified by:
      startHeartbeating in interface Heartbeatable

    • receiveHeartbeat

      public void receiveHeartbeat()
      Registers a received heartbeat ping from the server by updating the last contact timestamp.
      Specified by:
      receiveHeartbeat in interface Heartbeatable

    • sendHeartbeat

      public abstract void sendHeartbeat() throws Exception
      Sends a ping to the server to confirm this client is still active. The actual implementation varies depending on the network protocol (Socket or RMI).
      Specified by:
      sendHeartbeat in interface Heartbeatable
      Throws:
      Exception - if the ping fails to send due to network issues.

    • handleServerOffline

      public void handleServerOffline()
      Handles the catastrophic event of losing connection to the server. It halts the running loops, shuts down the heartbeat scheduler, prints an error, and forcibly terminates the client application.
